_comment: Promoted submissions to the attest-challenge benchmark. Written by the Yukon sync workflow. `baseline` is the reference number the challenge opened on, measured on the held-out split by the detector currently driving published verdicts.
baseline_note: The detector shipping in the repo today. It asks each question three ways, scores how much each endpoint agrees with itself, and subtracts that before comparing them, so a model being bad at arithmetic stops looking like fraud. Catches 8 of 14 swaps with 1 false accusation of 8, inside the budget.

history.note: mean similarity, swap below 0.45. Caught 12 of 14 but accused 4 of 8 honest providers, so the run was disqualified.
